project.name: ArogyaPlus
project.title: Smart Health Management System
project.description: Enterprise full-stack clinical platform supporting patient scheduling, real-time emergency ambulance dispatch, doctor digital prescriptions, telemedicine video rooms, super admin live telemetry, and 100% free OpenStreetMap & Leaflet GIS interactive mapping.

tech_stack.maps_gis: Leaflet.js (^1.9.4), Leaflet Routing Machine, OpenRouteService/OSRM, Overpass API, Nominatim API
tech_stack.frontend: Vanilla HTML5, Custom Clinical CSS System, ES6 JavaScript Modules

directories.middleware: JWT auth, rate limiting, error handling, request validation
directories.models: Mongoose schemas (User, Patient, Doctor, Appointment, Emergency, Ambulance, Hospital, Payment, etc.)
directories.routes: Express API endpoints (auth, appointment, ambulance, emergency, admin, doctor, map, payment, etc.)
directories.ui: Clinical portal pages for patient, doctor, admin, & super-admin
directories.ui/js: Reusable JS components: map.js, routing.js, geolocation.js, hospital.js, ambulance.js, emergency.js
directories.utils: Emergency queueing, WebPush services, symptom checker

routes.desc: GET live ambulance fleet marker locations

POST driving route, distance, ETA, & alternatives via OSRM/OpenRouteService

Super admin system monitoring & broadcast alerts

websocket_channels.desc: Super admin live telemetry & system alerts
Driver app emits live GPS updates
Server broadcasts smooth position update to all client maps

decisions.title: Separation of Sensitive Credentials
decisions.summary: Real API keys/passwords live strictly in .env (documented in SECRETS.md). SECRETS.md and .env are git-ignored.

decisions.title: Modular Clinical Dashboard UI Architecture
decisions.summary: Built with Vanilla HTML5, CSS custom properties, and page-specific JS modules for maximum speed and easy PWA caching.

decisions.title: Fast High-Speed JSON Memory System
decisions.summary: Replaced markdown text files with structured memory.json and executable CLI script memory.js for instant AI parsing and CLI updates.

decisions.title: 100% Free OpenStreetMap & Leaflet GIS Ecosystem Replacement
decisions.summary: Replaced Google Maps with free OpenStreetMap, Leaflet.js, Leaflet Routing Machine, OpenRouteService/OSRM, Overpass API, and Nominatim API.

rules: Read memory.json or run 'node .memory/memory.js status' at start of turn.
Check pending backlog before planning new features.
Never put real credentials in code or memory.json.
Update memory.json using 'node .memory/memory.js add-commit ...' after pushing git changes.
Ensure all Jest integration tests pass ('npm test') before declaring completion.
